title: Edit by document ID
summary: Revise an existing project document by ID.
purpose: Revise an existing project document by ID.
request: Read the latest `revision_no` with {{route:chat.document}}, then POST the full `content` and `expected_revision` to {{route:chat.document.revise}}. To create a document, POST `title` and `content` to {{route:chat.document.create}}.
response: A revision increments the revision number and preserves the ID. Omitting front matter preserves the existing header.
errors: On `revision_conflict`, reread and reapply the changes. On `404 document_not_found`, check the ID. Report read-mode refusals.
